name: fx-ai-creative-lab
description: Unified web-only FX AI Creative Lab: React/Vite frontend + TypeScript/Express AI backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace fx-creative-backend" "npm run dev --workspace fx-creative-app"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace fx-creative-backend && npm run build --workspace fx-creative-app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace fx-creative-backend && npm run typecheck --workspace fx-creative-app
